prompt: Design a UI for a e-commerce store in a Marvel-inspired superhero theme.

response.navbar: Sticky top bar in matte black with a thin red underline that animates left-to-right on hover; logo left, search center, cart icon right with a pulsing red badge for item count.
response.color_palette: Base: charcoal black (#161616) and off-white (#F2F2F2). Accent: comic red (#D62828) and electric blue (#2E5EAA) used sparingly for CTAs and hover states.
response.typography: Bold condensed display font for headings (comic-poster feel), clean grotesque sans-serif for body text so it stays readable at small sizes.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Primary buttons: angled-corner rectangles (not fully sharp, not fully rounded) that scale up 4% and gain a subtle drop shadow on hover, like a comic panel popping forward.
response.background_animation: Faint halftone-dot texture in the hero section that slowly parallax-scrolls; a subtle comic 'impact burst' animates in behind the hero headline on page load, then settles.
response.layout_notes: Hero banner with a featured hero/character product, grid-based product cards below with a slight card-tilt on hover, badge-style 'Limited Drop' tags on select items.

prompt: Design a UI for a SaaS landing page in a Minimalist Scandinavian theme.

response.navbar: Transparent navbar that turns solid white with a soft shadow after 60px scroll; generous whitespace, thin 1px divider under nav.
response.color_palette: Off-white (#FAFAF8), soft sage green (#A8C3A0) as primary accent, charcoal text (#2B2B2B). No more than one bright accent used per screen.
response.typography: A humanist sans-serif (e.g. Inter or similar) with generous line-height; headings use a slightly larger, lighter weight than expected for an airy feel.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Pill-shaped buttons, no shadow by default; on hover the fill lightens 8% and the button lifts 2px with a 150ms ease-out transition.
response.background_animation: None or nearly none — a single slow-fading gradient blob in the hero background is the only motion, kept under 5% opacity.
response.layout_notes: Single-column centered hero, generous 80px+ section padding, feature grid in 3 columns with icon + short text, plenty of negative space between sections.

prompt: Design a UI for a gaming platform in a Cyberpunk neon theme.

response.navbar: Fixed dark navbar (#0D0D14) with a glowing magenta/cyan gradient underline that follows the active nav item like a scanning cursor.
response.color_palette: Near-black background (#0D0D14), neon magenta (#FF2EBC) and neon cyan (#2EF3FF) as dual accents, muted purple-gray for secondary text.
response.typography: Angular, slightly futuristic display font for headings; monospace font for stats/numbers to reinforce the 'terminal' feel.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Outlined buttons with a neon border that fills with a gradient glow on hover, accompanied by a quick 100ms flicker animation on click.
response.background_animation: Subtle animated grid-line background receding toward a vanishing point, plus faint scanline overlay that loops continuously.
response.layout_notes: Card-based game tiles with glowing borders on hover, HUD-style stat bars, dark mode only (no light theme).

prompt: Design a UI for a bakery e-commerce site in a Cozy artisan theme.

response.navbar: Cream-colored navbar with a hand-drawn-style logo mark; nav links use a warm underline that grows from the center on hover.
response.color_palette: Warm cream (#FBF3E7), toasted brown (#8B5E3C), and dusty rose (#D9A6A0) accent for sale tags and highlights.
response.typography: A soft serif for headings to feel handcrafted, paired with a rounded sans-serif for body copy for easy reading.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Rounded, slightly textured-looking buttons; hover state adds a gentle warm shadow and a 3% scale-up over 200ms.
response.background_animation: Very subtle — a faint steam/wisp animation rising behind the hero product photo, looping slowly.
response.layout_notes: Photo-forward product grid, ingredient/story callouts between sections, sticky 'order for pickup/delivery' bar on mobile.

prompt: Design a UI for a personal banking app in a Modern fintech theme.

response.navbar: Clean top bar with logo left, minimal nav center, profile avatar right; switches to a bottom tab bar on mobile.
response.color_palette: White/near-white background, deep navy (#0B1F3A) for headers and primary text, single confident accent — emerald green (#1F9D55) — reserved for positive actions and success states.
response.typography: Neutral, highly legible sans-serif (numbers must be tabular/monospaced-aligned for balances and transaction lists).
response.buttons_and_transitions: Solid rounded-rectangle buttons, no unnecessary animation; state changes (loading, success) use simple, fast, unambiguous transitions under 200ms to build trust.
response.background_animation: None in core app screens; a soft animated line-chart draw-in is acceptable only on the analytics/dashboard screen.
response.layout_notes: Card-based balance summary at top, transaction list below with clear iconography per category, high contrast for accessibility.

prompt: Design a UI for a high-end apparel store in a Luxury fashion theme.

response.navbar: Ultra-minimal navbar, logo centered, nav links spaced wide apart in small caps; navbar background fully transparent over a full-bleed hero image.
response.color_palette: Monochrome: black, white, and a single warm gold (#B08D57) accent used only for price highlights and small details.
response.typography: A refined serif for the logo/headings, thin-weight sans-serif for everything else; heavy use of letter-spacing on labels.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Text-only or outline buttons (no filled shapes) with a slow, elegant underline-reveal on hover, transitions kept slow and deliberate (300–400ms).
response.background_animation: Large full-bleed editorial photography with a slow, subtle Ken Burns zoom on the hero image; nothing else moves.
response.layout_notes: Very sparse grid, large product photography, minimal text per product, oversized whitespace between sections to feel premium.

prompt: Design a UI for a learning app for children in a Playful kids education theme.

response.navbar: Rounded, colorful top bar with large friendly icons instead of text labels where possible; mascot character peeking from a corner.
response.color_palette: Bright primary palette — sunny yellow (#FFC93C), sky blue (#4EA8DE), coral (#FF6F59) — high contrast, high saturation, cheerful.
response.typography: Rounded, chunky, highly legible font for both headings and body; large font sizes throughout for young readers.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Big, tappable rounded buttons with a bouncy squash-and-stretch animation on press, plus a small confetti or star burst on task completion.
response.background_animation: Gentle floating clouds/stars drifting across the background at a slow, non-distracting pace.
response.layout_notes: Large touch targets, illustrated characters guiding each section, progress shown as a filling path/map rather than a plain bar.

prompt: Design a UI for a yoga and meditation studio site in a Calm wellness theme.

response.navbar: Translucent navbar over a soft gradient background, thin weight nav text, logo mark kept small and understated.
response.color_palette: Muted sage (#B7C9A8), warm sand (#EFE6D8), soft terracotta (#C97B5A) accent; low saturation throughout to feel calming.
response.typography: Light-weight serif for headings for a breathable, editorial feel; simple sans-serif for schedules and body text.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Soft rounded buttons with slow, gentle fade/scale transitions (250ms+); avoid anything snappy or abrupt.
response.background_animation: Slow-breathing radial gradient in the hero (subtly expands and contracts, mimicking a breath cycle) — very low opacity change.
response.layout_notes: Class schedule as a clean calendar grid, instructor bios with soft circular photos, generous vertical rhythm between sections.

prompt: Design a UI for a sneaker resale marketplace in a Streetwear sneaker culture theme.

response.navbar: Bold, high-contrast navbar with a thick colored bottom border; category chips (Nike, Jordan, Yeezy-style generic labels) scroll horizontally just below it.
response.color_palette: Off-white base, jet black text, one loud accent (electric orange #FF5E00) used for 'hot drop' tags and CTAs only.
response.typography: Heavy, condensed sans-serif for headings to feel like a hype poster; clean sans-serif for prices and details.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Blocky rectangular buttons with a sharp 1px offset shadow that shifts on hover for a sticker-like effect.
response.background_animation: Marquee-style scrolling ticker of recent sales/drops at the very top of the page.
response.layout_notes: Dense product grid, prominent 'last sale price' on cards, countdown timers on limited drops, sticky filter sidebar on desktop.

prompt: Design a UI for a houseplant e-commerce site in a Botanical plant shop theme.

response.navbar: Simple off-white navbar with a small leaf icon mark; nav underline in leafy green grows in on hover.
response.color_palette: Warm white (#FAF7F0), deep forest green (#2F5233), terracotta pot orange (#C1682F) as accent for tags and buttons.
response.typography: Friendly rounded sans-serif throughout, medium weight for headings, regular for care-instruction body copy.
response.buttons_and_transitions: Rounded pill buttons, on hover fill darkens slightly with a 150ms ease transition, small leaf icon animates in next to 'Add to cart'.
response.background_animation: Subtle leaf-shadow texture drifting very slowly across light background areas.
response.layout_notes: Product cards show a light-requirement icon and difficulty badge, care-guide accordion on product pages, warm lifestyle photography.
